Messages.Author: Nick Lee
Messages.Body:
>Can two pulled fangs be played on a vampire a) at all
> b) in one turn

>if two can be played in one turn does this mean that I can burn a vampire
>with pilled fangs

>ie hit a vampire on 2 for 2 pull his fangs twice and burn??

I believe that you wouldn't be able to play the second pulled fangs at all.
The first pulled fangs would put the target vampire in torpor before you
could play the second pulled fangs. Besides, I'm not sure you can play two
of the same card in the same round of combat. (except for strike cards)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <cs959651-130...@130.95.80.112>,

Peter Gordon WILSMORE <cs95...@cs.uwa.edu.au> wrote:
>Can two pulled fangs be played on a vampire a) at all
> b) in one turn
>
>if two can be played in one turn does this mean that I can burn a vampire
>with pilled fangs
>
>ie hit a vampire on 2 for 2 pull his fangs twice and burn??

The two agg. must come From the same source, so no, you can't burn him.
If by "the same turn" you mean "in the same combat, then the answer there
is no as well, unless he prevents the agg damage from the first pulled
fangs - which would make the question pointless anyhow.
In other ways - same turn but different combat (after being rescued/untapping,
etc.) or on a subsequent turn, he is again a valid target for Pulled Fangs.

Messages.Author: James R. McClure Jr.
Messages.Body:
cs95...@cs.uwa.edu.au (Peter Gordon WILSMORE) wrote:
>Can two pulled fangs be played on a vampire a) at all
> b) in one turn

Peace Peter,

Good question. I don't know. Why would you?

>if two can be played in one turn does this mean that I can burn a vampire
>with pilled fangs

No. It takes X+2 aggr dam FROM A SINGLE STRIKE to burn a vamp (where X is vamp's
current blood pool). Since each PF does one aggr dam individually, you cannot
burn a vamp like this.

Messages.Body:
In article <Pine.SOL.3.91.950614172849.26820C-100000@gladstone>,

Algustas <cfr...@gladstone.uoregon.edu> wrote:
>On 13 Jun 1995, L. Scott Johnson wrote:
>> The two agg. must come From the same source, so no, you can't burn him.
>> If by "the same turn" you mean "in the same combat, then the answer there
>> is no as well, unless he prevents the agg damage from the first pulled
>> fangs - which would make the question pointless anyhow.
>

> This does bring up an interesting question though, how does
>pulled fangs interact with undead persistence? What if he did use two of
>them? I would think that absolutely nothing would happen until combat was
>over and the vamp would then go to Torpor.

Correct - each pulled fangs would do 1 agg - each 1 agg would simply re-send
the vampire to torpor with no further effect.

> If a vamp takes enough aggrevated damage to burn it in one shot
>then undead persistence wouldn't interfere with the vamp being burned,
>correct?

Correct - burned in combat does not have to pass thru torpor and would be
unaffected by Undead Persistence.
